provenance_note: Agriculture v2 inverts every v1 failure (artifact de1f0d4adb49...): no fixed row lattice (per-parcel direction field + variable spacing), clods = world-PRF marked point process (no analytic stamp reuse), whole-domain world-coordinate model (no per-tile priority-flood hydrology), every scalar claim hash-bound to a source artifact. Frozen BEFORE the measurement run; thresholds below are the acceptance gates.

site.comment: Dev tile is fully interior to parcel 3477279 (v1-comparable). Boundary window straddles the parcel west edge (E~679007) for taper + boundary-transition QA and the form-free-ground taper gate. Cross-parcel AOI holds 7 arable parcels for the direction-variation gate.

marzahn_dual_scale_facts.note: Marzahn, Seidel & Ludwig 2012, Remote Sens. 4:2016-2032, doi:10.3390/rs4072016. Table 7 detrended two-scale roughness (units cm): s = RMS height, l = autocorrelation length; scale 1 (small) = seedbed rows + soil clods/aggregates; scale 2 (large) = wheel tracks. Table 1 (Roemkens): random roughness 2-200 mm (clods/aggregates), oriented roughness 200-400 mm (rows/tillage). Section 3.2: wheel tracks are sharply bounded with 4-6 cm relief to the surrounding seedbed and a ~200 cm periodicity; s2 > s1 (large scale rougher).

operation_unknown_mixture.note: Management state (ploughed/seedbed/crusted/rolled) is NOT observed on this parcel. Rather than a silent single-look default, an explicit mixture over Marzahn Table 5 states drives a spatial state field (world-PRF macro-cells assigned by these weights); each state carries development-hypothesis form scalings. Weights follow the Table 5 sample census (2 seedbed / 5 crusted seedbed / 1 smooth crusted of 8 ESUs).

soil_texture.note: Mullakaart dev-tile polygons: LP (dominant, Lihtloimis v1sl/v1ls, Boniteet 47, Kivisus II, Huumus 23-26) and E2I (Lihtloimis sl/ls, Boniteet 40). Texture sl/ls = sandy loam over loamy sand, weakly gravelly. Friable medium-light texture -> moderate clod size multiplier. Bound as evidence; NOT calibrated truth.

row_scale_grounding: row_spacing_mean 0.40 m is anchored to the coarse end of the Roemkens (Table 1, cited in the bound Marzahn 2012 PDF) oriented-roughness band 200-400 mm (rows/tillage patterns) and is consistent with Marzahn's wide-row ESUs (sugar beet 5/8, maize, onion). This is well separated from the ~2.0 m wheel-track scale (ratio ~5) and above the 0.14-0.30 m clod band, so the added-relief spectrum shows two distinct scales. Correction rationale (run-2): run-1 used an ungrounded 0.22 m generic-cereal spacing whose row peak was spectrally buried under the wheel-track skirt; all gate thresholds stayed frozen.
